shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls src app pages 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cd /workspace; ls __agent_eval__; cat next.config.ts; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "proxy.ts" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i x-request-id; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/foo | grep -i x-request-id; sleep 1; cat /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start"
